'''2002 Ralltiir Regionals''' was a constructed Star Wars CCG regional in Mainz on 19 May 2002 (Germany–Switzerland–Austria). [[Bastian Winkelhaus]] won. [[Vjeko Keskic]] finished 3rd (5–1 into the final four) with a [[Dark]] [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|Court Of The Vile Gangster]] list (''Court Likes Direct Damage aka Gailid Superstar'').<ref name="dt-23606">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23606 Court Likes Direct Damage aka Gailid Superstar], DeckTech (Vjeko "mighty_maul" Keskic, 27 May 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/23606/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/23606/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009130803/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23606/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 19 May 2002
* '''Site:''' Mainz
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Bastian Winkelhaus]]
